firing.source: export function row() { let unit_price = 1; return { unit_price }; }

findings.message: The variable "unit_price" is a value, so spell it in lowerCamelCase: "unitPrice". Values are spelled in lowerCamelCase and types in UpperCamelCase, so a reader tells which is which at a glance, and an underscore inside a name marks a word boundary the camel case already marks.

firing.fixedSource: export function row() { let unitPrice = 1; return { unit_price: unitPrice }; }
